article: Open the Classic Context Menu in Windows 11
scope: Compared the full Japanese source and all twelve translations, registry instructions and rollback, Windows 11 current built-in options, dates, screenshots, and Microsoft Support references.
findings: Removed duplicate future dates; retained publication date 2024-03-30 and set lastmod to 2026-11-24.
Fixed the missing step number and clarified the nested InprocServer32 key and rollback.
Added Microsoft-documented Show more options and keyboard methods as the preferred way to open the classic menu.
Qualified the registry change as an unofficial, version-dependent workaround rather than promising that it always restores the classic menu.
